versions.text: Criterion: Verify that lateral translation is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.2.3.13 Lateral translation. b. 5.2.3.13.1 Dynamic response to lateral translation controller input. c. 5.2.3.13.2 Steady-state response to lateral translation controller input. d. 5.2.3.13.3 Lateral translation controller forces and displacements. e. 5.2.3.13.4 Crew restraints. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.
